Third-Party Notice: LexCAT
==========================

WikiKB includes unchanged binary archives of the LexCAT 0.0.16 lexical
retrieval runtime in this directory. The LexCAT executables
are not licensed under WikiKB's MIT License.

The LexCAT executables remain subject to their copyright holder's separate
terms. The redistribution authorization above does not provide LexCAT source
code or grant permission to modify, sublicense, or relicense the executables.
Contact the WikiKB maintainer before redistributing LexCAT separately from an
unchanged WikiKB distribution.

LexCAT is model-free. No retrieval model is downloaded, installed, or
redistributed with these archives, and the runtime never calls an embedding
service.
